usedFor: When a Docusign envelope is fully signed, Google Drive creates a folder for it.

bestTemplate.name: “New Envelope Completed” in Docusign, then “Create Folder” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A fully signed envelope is a closed deal, so it gets a folder for onboarding files.

watchOut: “New Envelope Completed” waits for every recipient, and “Create Folder” never reuses an existing folder.
